single.rationale: Scotts Miracle-Gro shows improving profitability after two years of losses (returning to operating income of $359M in FY2025), but faces structural headwinds with declining revenues (-4.5% 3-year CAGR) and heavy debt ($2.1B net debt vs $3.1B market cap). The concentration risk with Home Depot and Lowe's, along with the dependence on the Monsanto Roundup agreement, creates vulnerability despite improving margins.
